skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Sweetness to the Heart
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Sweetness to the Heart. Outfit Nymph put together in preparation for the tea party. Light and comfortable, with just the right amount of sweetness. Maybe she has her own sugary secret recipe?
skins.quote: After trying the desserts Nymph brought along, there is not a soul who is not wondering about the secret behind their incredible sweetness.
